subject.title: fix(build): add explicit ESM format to nodeBuildConfig for type module package

question: Should this optional ESM build-contract pin land, and if so how should the closing metadata for the canonical document-extract regression be neutralized first?
rationale: The code change is small and coherent, but the behavioral fix claim is not supported by the tsdown contract and the branch metadata can affect the open user-facing regression issue.

options.title: Merge As Cleanup After Metadata Fix
options.body: Rewrite or squash away the issue-closing wording, then merge the explicit ESM pin as defensive build cleanup only.

options.title: Merge And Manually Guard The Issue
options.body: A maintainer may accept the cleanup and manually ensure the canonical regression remains open or is corrected after merge.

options.title: Close The Cleanup PR
options.body: If maintainers do not want a no-op pin against a current dependency default, close this PR and leave the regression with its canonical tracking path.

recommendation.title: Merge As Cleanup After Metadata Fix
recommendation.body: Rewrite or squash away the issue-closing wording, then merge the explicit ESM pin as defensive build cleanup only.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has recent history across the relevant build/package and bundled plugin runtime surfaces, making him the best available routing owner for the merge-risk choice.
